paragraphs.text: The Army of the Valley was an army of the eastern Domains in the time before the Brothers' War .

It formed after the destruction of the village of Mors Ridge when Palladia-Mors was freed. The town's remaining soldiers joined with Red Donald 's troops. It fought off Palladia-Mors's horde of undead and goblins , led by the orc general Balgot . When Red Donald was killed in battle against Balgot, his daughter Ad'Amra became the general of the army and led until the battle was done and the army disbanded.
